title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the time taken must be correctly stated as t = 10^4 s.

title: Equation Use
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the equation L^2 = nl^2 to relate displacement, mean free path, and number of collisions.

title: Substitution
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly substitute the values for l and v into the derived equation for time.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the mean free path or the velocity.
